errors.text_span: динамиката на приходите от индустрията за преработка на отпадъци в България
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the chart shows revenue from the waste processing industry. According to the provided caption, the chart shows "Динамика ПЧИ", which translates to "Dynamics of FDI (Foreign Direct Investment)". The description seems to have incorrectly inferred the topic from the paper's title instead of the figure's own caption.

errors.text_span: Отново, тече вляво до 2018 и вдясно до 2022.
errors.evidence: This sentence is awkwardly phrased and confusing. It's a redundant and unclear way of describing the range of the x-axis, which was already stated correctly.
The y-axis scale shown in the figure extends up to 5,000,000, not 4,800,000.
The description states that the y-axis intervals are equal but fails to specify their value, which is 200,000 as indicated by the gridlines.

errors.text_span: Има една линия, изобразяваща динамиката на приходите.
errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the chart contains two distinct visual elements: a solid line (likely a trendline) and a scatter plot of many individual data points. It incorrectly treats them as a single entity.
The line and the corresponding data points for 2018 begin at a value of approximately 4,150,000, not 3,800,000, which is the minimum value on the axis.
The line and the data points in 2022 end at a value closer to 4,850,000, which is noticeably higher than the stated 4,800,000.
There are significantly more than six markers on the plot; a visual count reveals approximately 25-30 markers.
The markers are not located on the line. They are scattered around the line, which appears to function as a trendline for the data points.

errors.text_span: и представляват индивидуални точки от данни за всяка година.
errors.evidence: This is an unsubstantiated assumption. Since there are far more markers than years, it is incorrect to state they represent data for each year (implying one point per year). The chart provides no information on the time frequency of the points.
